$comment: One machine's own gate settings, measured on an Apple Silicon laptop with 10 cores (4 performance, 6 efficiency), 16 GB RAM and Docker Desktop at 6 CPUs and 10 GiB, with the workspace stack up. Copy it to ~/.config/tim/machine.json (or point TIM_MACHINE_CONFIG at it) and change the numbers for your machine: machine-tuning.md beside this file says how to measure them. Each workers key is <repo>/<rung> from gates.json; the gate passes the count as --workers after the rung's scope. parallelRepos and stackAfterLocal replace gates.json's on this machine only. Without the file, the gate runs as gates.json and each script say.
